exclusions.name: Elena Cruz
exclusions.why_safe: She oversees receipts but does not control collection rate or shipping schedule, so her actions do not affect the number of units received.

exclusions.name: Other hospitals or blood centres
exclusions.why_safe: The question only concerns St. Vincent regional hospital and Cascade regional blood centre. Other entities are irrelevant.

exclusions.name: Weekend collections
exclusions.why_safe: The drive is only open Monday to Friday, so weekend collections do not occur.

exclusions.name: Friday collection
exclusions.why_safe: The deadline is Friday noon, and the drive opens at 9am Friday, but any collection on Friday would not be shipped before the deadline (next shipment is Tuesday/Thursday). However, the hospital could potentially receive units from Friday collection if shipped immediately? The evidence says shipments are only Tuesday and Thursday at 4pm, so Friday collection cannot be shipped before Friday noon. Thus, excluding Friday collection is safe.

uncertainties.meaning: The exact number of units collected on Monday is unknown; it depends on the collection rate and hours open. The rate is 12 units/hour, and the drive is open 9am-5pm (8 hours), so 96 units could be collected, but actual may vary.
The number of units collected on Tuesday before the 4pm shipment cutoff is unknown. The drive is open 9am-4pm (7 hours), so up to 84 units could be collected, but actual may vary.
The number of units collected on Wednesday is unknown. The drive is open 9am-5pm (8 hours), so up to 96 units could be collected, but actual may vary.
The number of units collected on Thursday before the 4pm shipment cutoff is unknown. The drive is open 9am-4pm (7 hours), so up to 84 units could be collected, but actual may vary.
The centre's stock after the Tuesday shipment is unknown because it depends on Monday and Tuesday collections and the initial stock of 40 units, minus the 150 units shipped.
Whether the centre has at least 150 units to ship on Tuesday is uncertain because it depends on Monday and Tuesday collections.
Whether the centre has at least 150 units to ship on Thursday is uncertain because it depends on collections after Tuesday shipment.

Whether the Tuesday shipment is received by the hospital before Friday noon is uncertain because the shipment departs at 4pm Tuesday and takes 3 hours, arriving around 7pm Tuesday, so it is received well before Friday noon. This is actually certain, but included for completeness.

Whether the Thursday shipment is received by the hospital before Friday noon is uncertain because the shipment departs at 4pm Thursday and takes 3 hours, arriving around 7pm Thursday, so it is received before Friday noon. This is actually certain, but included for completeness.
